phandati.cp: phad + ṁ - a. trembles; throbs; stirs.

U: PHAṆDATI：（phad+ṃ+a） run rẩy，nhảy hay đập mạnh （mạch），lay động [aor] phandi [pp] --dita [prp] --damāna [abs] --ditvā
S: phandati：[spand] 動揺す，震える，戦慄す．ppr．phandant； pp．phandita； caus．phandāpeti； ppr．phandāpayant 震えさせつつ，動揺させながら．
D: Phandati，（phad + ŋ-a），战栗，悸动，激起。【过】 phandi。 【过分】 ~dita。【现分】 ~damāna，【独】 ~detvā。（p233）
F: Phandati，（phad（梵spand）颤抖+ṁ-a），战栗（to throb，palpitate）。2．激起，悸动，搅乱（to twitch，tremble，move，stir）。【过】phandi。【过分】phandita。【现分】phandamāna，【独】phandetvā。

DOP: phandati pr. 3 sg. [ S. spandate], moves slightly, stirs; twitches; trembles; S I 174, 13 (punappunaṃ kilamati ~ati ca); III 141, 19 (gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ṭhite majjhantike kāle marīcikā ~ati, Be, Se so; Ce marīci; Ee omits ~ati); Th 49 (na me taṃ ~ati cittaṃ ekattanirataṃ hi me); Ja II 234, 15* (pakkhī na ~ati); IV 325, 2 (eko va hattho … ekā dāṭhā naccati calati ~ati sesaṃ niccalaṃ ahosi); VI 113, 1* (~anti macchā va thalamhi khittā); 557, 7* (dakkhiṇakkhi ca ~ati); Ps V 17, 3 (kathetukāmo gīvaṃ paggaṇhāti hanukaṃ cāleti mukhaṃ assa ~ati); — part.pr. ( a ) phanda(t), mfn. , D I 52, 23 (~ato phandāpayato … na karīyati pāpaṃ; Sv 159, 21 foll.: paraṃ ~antaṃ phandanakāle sayaṃ pi ~ato taṃ pi ~āpayato) ≠ M I 404, 23 = S IV 349, 9 ; ( b ) phandanta, mfn. , Sn 587 (passa … ~ante v’ idha pāṇine); ( c ) phandamāna, mfn. , A IV 290, 16* (pajaṃ jātijarūpetaṃ ~amānaṃ avekkhati); Sn 936 (~amānaṃ pajaṃ disvā macche appodake yathā); Vv 52:24; Ja V 255, 22* ; Ap 350, 20 (marīcike ~amāne); — neg. aphandamāna, mfn. , S IV 203, 9 (aphandamānena cittena, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se aphandiyamānena); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) phandi, Pj I 233, 27 (bhikkhūnaṃ … hadayaṃ ~i); ( b ) phandittha, Sv 712, 12 (mā ~ittha rañño āṇā ti); — pp phandita , mfn. and n. [ S. spandita], 1. ( mfn. ) moved, stirred; unstable; Paṭis I 165, 26 (kāyo pi cittaṃ pi sāraddhā honti iñjitā ca ~ā ca); 166, 23* (kāyo pi ~o hoti; Paṭis-a 473, 2 : ~o ti mandakampito); — neg. aphandita, mfn. , Paṭis I 166, 26* ; Ap-a 286, 19 (aphanditaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce akampitaṃ; Ee wr aphandhitaṃ); — 2. ( n. ) movement, stirring; trembling; M II 24, 28 (kuto pana kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karissati aññatra ~-mattā); Ap 8, 3 (jiya ~āni, Be so; Ce vijiya; Ee, Se jitaphanditāni; Ap-a 129, 33 : ~ānī ti ~āni dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni jinitvā, Be, Se so; Ce jitabandhanāni sabbāni tāni dvāsaṭṭhi …; Ee jitabandhitānī ti bandhikāni sabbāni tāni dvāsaṭṭhi …); Vibh 390, 30 (katamāni nava ~āni); Mp II 207, 10 (imāni satta … ~ani); — ifc see kāya-; — caus. ( a ) neg. part.pr. aphandenta, mfn. , Sp 323, 7 (taṃ aphandento hatthena āmasati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr aphandanto); — caus. ( b ) pr. 3 sg. phandāpeti , ~ayati , moves, stirs; makes tremble; Vin III 48, 3 (kumbhiṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa, ~eti āpatti thullaccayassa); Ja VI 7, 25 (hatthaṃ vā pādaṃ vā ~eti); Ps III 390, 18 (eko ito c’ ito ca [pattaṃ] ~eti); Sadd 865, 14 (~ayate); — part.pr. ( a ) phandāpenta, mfn. , Sp 314, 9 ; Vibh-a 475, 8 (eḷakā viya mukhaṃ ~entā); ( b ) phandāpaya(t), mfn. , D I 52, 24 (phandato ~ayato) = M I 404, 23 = S IV 349, 9 ; ( c ) phandāpayamāna, mfn. , Vism 142, 23 (vātagahaṇatthaṃ pakkhe ~ayamānassa [mahāsakuṇassa] gamanaṃ viya) = As 115, 14 ; — absol. phandāpetvā, Sp 314, 9 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits ).

phandanajātaka.p: [Phandana+jātaka] (na) CL=10 Phandana story, a fight between a deity that lives on a Malay lac tree and a black bear.
pn:
Phandanajātaka (Ja 475). A lion acquired the habit of going to lie under a phandana-tree, but one day a branch fell on his shoulder and hurt him. The lion thereupon conceived an enmity against the tree, and when a carpenter came in search of wood for a cartwheel, suggested to him that he should cut down that very tree as the wood would be excellent for his purpose. The deity of the tree, discovering this, appeared before the carpenter and told him that if he placed four inches of the hide of a lion on the rim of his wheel its value would be greatly enhanced.

The carpenter, adopting both suggestions, killed the lion and cut down the tree (Ja.iv.207ff). This was one of the stories related by the Buddha in the course of the quarrel between the Sākiyans and the Koḷiyans. Snp-a.i.358.

Phaṇahatthaka：Người có những ngón tay dính vào nhau nhìn như cánh dơi （Samantapāsādikā giải thích；Yassa vaggulipakkhakā viya aṇguliyo sambaddhā honti）．Hạng này không được thọ đại giới．Nhưng nếu dĩ lỡ，giới phẩm vẫn thành tựu，chỉ thầy tổ phạm Tác Ác．Người có bàn tay dư ngón cũng nên cắt bỏ bớt và chờ lành lặn mới thọ đại giới （Adhikangulim chinditvā phāsukam katvā pabbājetabbo）

phaṇahatthaka：ဖဏဟတ္ထက（တိ）
[ဖဏ+ဟတ္ထ+က]
ပါးပျဉ်းနှင့်တူသော လက်ရှိသော （သဒ္ဒတ္ထ）၊ အချင်းချင်းစပ်သော လက်ချောင်းရှိသော （အဓိပ္ပါယတ္ထ） လက်ချောင်းပူကပ်သော၊ သူ။ （လက်ပျစ်သောသူ။ သျ）။
